verdict.rationale: There is a concrete probe showing Kong publishes an llms.txt with 'Disallow-Training: /' signaling a preference against AI training use of its own site content, but this is about Kong's own website/content policy, not a feature that lets an AI-native user of Kong's products prevent their data from training AI models. No documentation shows a user-facing control, API, or gateway policy for opting data out of model training. Missing for 10: a documented product feature/API/policy letting end-users control or block their data from being used in AI training, first-party docs on data-use/training opt-out for Gateway/AI Gateway/Insomnia AI features, and independent corroboration.
